scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional proof; exact-rational tests corroborate but do not certify infinite quantifiers. No independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The general zero-diagonal 3-state eigenvalue region is prior work (Ran–Teng 2024, Proposition 6); the new classification fixes the stationary distribution. Three-state zero-diagonal row-stochastic kernels with positive stationary law and maximum mass < 1/2; spectral radius only, not finite-time mixing. Related matrix-root paper full text unavailable and historical equivalents possible.
title: A sharp stationary-concentration threshold for three-state mutation spectra
